Story: The Power of Persistence: Once there was a young boy named Rafi who dreamed of becoming a great programmer. Every day after school, he would sit in front of his old computer and practice coding. At first, he failed many times. His code had errors, and his programs often crashed. But Rafi never gave up. He believed that every mistake was a lesson, and every failure was a step closer to success. One day, after months of hard work, he finally built his own typing tutor app. His friends and teachers were amazed. Rafi smiled and said, 'Success is not about being perfect; it is about never stopping.'
